left.raw_text:
Inclusion Criteria:
  -  Patients of any age with a diagnosis of familial dysautonomia (FD) [AND]  with molecular confirmation of the IKBKAP mutation

right.raw_text:
-  Ability to provide informed consent (or assent) and comply with the study protocol
Exclusion Criteria:
  -  Subjects that do not wish to be a part of the study
